The BitNest authors report 1.48–1.61× end-to-end decoding speedups over FP16 autoregressive decoding across four 7B–8B models and six workloads, with a 95.2% average speculative-token acceptance rate.
On a Jetson Orin NX with 16 GB, the authors report a 10K-token maximum context for LLaMA-2-7B versus 6K with W8A8 decoding, while the paper tests self-speculation rather than separate draft models.
